dates.title: FGCU - Application deadlines (freshman and international tables; no years printed)

test_policy.notes: Required by Florida Board of Governors rule: first-time-in-college applicants must submit SAT, ACT or CLT scores (not required for the 'freshman earning an AA degree' option). The international FAQ says ACT or SAT scores are required for applicants with fewer than 60 transferable hours and mentions no waiver for internationals; a first-time freshman who submits a document-by-document credential evaluation without a GPA must have ACT 21 or SAT 1060. Admitted-student averages listed on the freshman page: GPA 4.16, SAT 1140, ACT 23, CLT 76. Scores submitted after February are not guaranteed a decision for the fall term.

requirements.notes: Non-refundable $30 fee (international FAQ: paid in US dollars from a US bank; fee waivers exist for SAT/ACT, NACAC and Common App requests on the freshman page). Foreign transcripts need a NACES credential evaluation (document-by-document for high school; GPA optional). Proof of funds for one academic year on an original Financial Statement Form dated within 6 months of entry. 18 high school units (4 English, 4 math, 3 science, 3 social science, 2 same-language foreign language, 2 electives); weighted GPA is used (AP/IB/dual enrollment +1, honors +0.5). Essays and recommendations are not mentioned on the pages read.

deadlines.label: International preferred application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: International table (applies to freshman, transfer and second-bachelor's applicants): application opens Aug 1, preferred deadline July 1, deposit Aug 1; no year is printed, so fall 2027 is assumed. Applications after the deadline are processed on a space-available basis. FGCU advises starting 6-12 months ahead because the I-20 needs complete documents.

deadlines.label: Freshman Early Action (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: From the separate freshman table, not the international one; decisions in December, supplemental items due Nov 15. Freshman merit scholarships give preference to applicants who apply by Nov 1 (the pages do not say whether internationals are eligible). Year not printed.

deadlines.label: Freshman Regular Decision (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: From the freshman table; the international table lists July 1 as the preferred date. Year not printed.

deadlines.label: International admissions deposit (fall)
deadlines.notes: Deposit is non-refundable and applies only to the admitted term (freshman fall deposit is May 1 for Early Action).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt if English is the official language of the home country, if you attended and graduated from a US high school for 4 years, hold a degree from a US college or university, earned a C or better in English Composition 1 and 2, or hold an Associate of Arts from a Florida public college. Meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission. Scores must be sent by the testing agency; the international page says no more than 2 years old, the FAQ and application-process page say 3 years. FGCU's Intensive English Language Program (IELP) is a separate language course; the page describes no conditional-admission or pathway route into the degree (Duolingo 80 to enter its Advanced 1 level).

english.notes: Internet-based 79 (computer-based 213, paper-based 550). No separate score on the new 1-6 scale is published.

aid.notes: International students are not eligible for federal aid. Per the Common Data Set, 179 nonresident undergraduates received non-need-based aid from the college's own funds, averaging $10,330; the admissions pages publish no international merit amounts. Global Learning Grant: up to $500 per semester for F-1/F-2/H-1B students who have completed two semesters at FGCU.

majors.program: Nursing, Music, Athletic Training, PGM (specialized admissions programs)
majors.notes: Students are admitted to FGCU as pre-majors and submit a supplemental application later, typically in sophomore year; not decided at freshman admission. Capacity is not stated on the page.

toefl.note: FGCU pages do not print a TOEFL institution code.

pte.note: PTE is not listed as accepted on the pages read.
